summary.name: Cog
summary.one_liner: Cog is a free, open source audio player for macOS (OS X) that plays a wide range of lossless and lossy audio formats, though its homepage announces the project is no longer actively developed.
use_cases: play flac or ogg files on a mac
play lossless audio formats like wavpack and monkeys audio
play apple lossless files on macos
find a free open source music player for mac
play musepack or shorten audio files
summary.what_it_does: Cog is a free, open source audio player for Mac OS X. The page lists support for Ogg Vorbis, MP3, FLAC, Musepack, Monkeys Audio, Shorten, WavPack, AAC, and Apple Lossless, plus "and more". The homepage has a news notice dated February 5, 2021 saying the project is dead and the author has had little time for it for about a decade, and it points users to other projects that have continued the work. The forums are now a read-only archive. Directory listings on awesome-mac and open-source-mac-os-apps describe Cog as free and open source, with a link to its GitHub repository and an App Store listing.
notable: Open source, with source code on GitHub under losnoco/cog
Broad codec support including FLAC, WavPack, Monkey's Audio, Musepack and Apple Lossless
Also listed on the Mac App Store
caveats: Homepage says the project is dead and no longer actively developed (news dated February 5, 2021)
Forums are a read-only archive, so login and registration may not work
